text: agent_workspace branch may not exist on the remote for a fresh pipeline run; create it once from main with git checkout -b agent_workspace origin/main && gh-as-agent push --branch agent_workspace

When candidates.json has zero candidates and coverage.json has empty sinkGaps/surfaceGaps, the security-work/triage.json should be {addressedVerdictRound:0, candidates:[], gaps:[]} and all findings files stay [].
When artifacts.jsonl has a rebase merge conflict, resolve by preserving all JSONL lines from both sides (no entries lost) and continuing with git -c user.email=... -c user.name=... rebase --continue

When applying security:approved after a previous run already set it, first remove security:analysis-ready then add security:approved — this ensures the downstream label event fires even if the approved label was already present.

When artifacts.jsonl hits a rebase conflict (multiple pipeline agents pushing concurrently), resolve by keeping all lines from both sides — it is an append-only ledger; never discard either side's entries.
When osv-scanner scan source syntax is not found (exit 127), use: osv-scanner scan -r --format json <dir> (the 'source' subcommand was removed in v1.9.x).
On git rebase --continue when committer identity is unknown, prefix with GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL and GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL env vars matching the agent identity.
When multiple pipeline agents push to agent_workspace concurrently, the artifacts.jsonl merge conflict must be resolved by keeping all entries from both sides (append-only log).
